I had zero sex after returning from the beach last night. But I suppose that’s just what I get for insulting an entire spa worth of girls by sneaking away while they were fighting over my penis.
lines.zh: 昨晚从海滩回来之后，我一次爱都没做成。不过这也算我活该——她们正为我的阴茎争得不可开交，我却溜了，等于侮辱了一整间水疗馆的姑娘。

lines.en: I imagine today will be different, though. Because, with an entire class worth of girls on the way here right now, there is bound to be at least one or two of them horny enough to still sleep with me despite being slighted.
lines.zh: 不过我想今天会不一样。毕竟现在有一整个班的女生正在赶来的路上，其中少说也有一两个会发情到愿意跟我上床，哪怕刚被我怠慢过。

lines.en: Either that or this is where my story ends. And everything from this point on becomes the typical all-ages romantic comedy it was meant to be before I showed up and set fire to it with my rampant libido.
lines.zh: 要么就是我的故事到此为止。从这一刻起，一切都变回它原本该是的那种全年龄恋爱喜剧——在我出现、用我泛滥的性欲把它一把火烧掉之前的样子。

lines.en: Ready to ruin some lives and subsequently complain about it, I slide the door of my room (which I slept in alone, thank you very much) open and step out into the sun.
lines.zh: 准备好去毁掉几个人生、然后再为此抱怨一番，我拉开房门（这间房是我一个人睡的，多谢关心），走到阳光里。

lines.en: Thankfully, I encounter three of my co-stars immediately afterward and don’t have to stand around trying not to be judged by you anymore.
lines.zh: 谢天谢地，我马上就遇到了三位同行出演的搭档，不必再杵在这儿、努力装作没被你评判。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday1
Hooray for adult companionship that I will definitely maintain throughout the weekend and not accidentally destroy in one way or another.
lines.zh: 万岁，成年人的陪伴——这个周末我一定会好好维持，绝不会以某种方式不小心毁掉。

lines.en: : Morning, Senpai! Whatcha up to?
lines.zh: : 早上好，Senpai！你在干嘛呢？

lines.en: : Oh, just foreshadowing. You guys are here early.
lines.zh: : 哦，就是铺垫一下。你们来得真早。

lines.en: : I want to fucking die.
lines.zh: : 我他妈想死。

lines.en: : I got to drive the school bus! And to Wakana’s dismay, we only almost died once.
lines.zh: : 校车是我开的！而且让 Wakana 失望的是，我们只差点死了一次。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday2
: You let her behind the wheel of a vehicle students were inside of? I thought you were supposed to be keeping everyone safe in my absence?
lines.zh: : 你让她开了一辆坐着学生的车？我不在的时候，你不是该负责保证大家安全的吗？

lines.en: : Hey, man. If I can drive the Dir En Grey tour bus from Kyushu to Kanto after their regular driver mysteriously drowned in a soapland, I think I can handle getting from the school to here in mostly one piece.
lines.zh: : 嘿，老兄。既然 Dir En Grey 的常规司机在一家 soapland 里离奇淹死之后，我都能把他们的巡演大巴从九州开到关东，我想从学校开到这儿、大体上保持完整，还是没问题的。

lines.en: : Which is great since all of us dying a fiery crash would probably spawn some sort of melodramatic anime I wouldn’t be able to collect royalties for on account of being a ghost.
lines.zh: : 这很好，因为要是我们全都葬身一场烈焰车祸，大概会催生出某种狗血动画，而我因为是鬼，还收不到版税。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday3
: Please remember who you’re talking to while dropping hypotheticals like that. The last thing I need this weekend is Arakawa stealing my thunder in the department of sorrow.
lines.zh: : 你抛这种假设的时候，麻烦记清楚你在跟谁说话。这个周末我最不需要的，就是 Arakawa 在「悲伤」这门功课上抢我的风头。

lines.en: : Department of Sorrow would be a cool band name. Can I drive the tour bus for them too?
lines.zh: : 「悲伤部」当乐队名挺酷的。他们的巡演大巴也能让我开吗？

lines.en: : {size=-2}Just hang on until tonight, Wakana. We will cure your misery with all the alcohol you can possibly stomach. Which is pretty much all of it. So there’s a chance we might accidentally usher in a new prohibition tonight.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}撑到今晚就好，Wakana。我们会用你胃装得下的所有酒来治好你的痛苦。而你的胃基本装得下所有酒。所以今晚我们有可能不小心又开启一次禁酒令。{/size}

lines.en: : Do you guys have some sort of occasion planned?
lines.zh: : 你们是有什么活动安排吗？

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday4
: Yeah, and you’re coming. It’s Friday, which means it’s time for all of us to get hammered since we can’t exactly go to the bar while we’re chaperoning a field trip.
lines.zh: : 有，而且你得来。今天是周五，意味着我们大家该喝个烂醉了——毕竟带着学生出来郊游的时候，我们总不能跑去酒吧。

lines.en: : You can’t exactly chaperone a field trip while hammered either, can you?
lines.zh: : 可你们也不能烂醉着去带学生郊游啊，对吧？

lines.en: : No, but we can probably leave them alone for a couple hours without anybody getting into trouble. Especially if you’re with us, which you will be.
lines.zh: : 是不能，但把他们单独放上几个小时，应该也不会出什么乱子。尤其是有你在的话——而你会来的。

lines.en: : I did bring a leash if you try and refuse. And I think all of us would very much enjoy getting to use it on you as an FYI.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢拒绝，我可是带了牵引绳的。顺便说一句，我们几个都会非常乐意把它用在你身上。

lines.en: : Why are you even here, Arakawa?
lines.zh: : 你到底为什么在这儿，Arakawa？

lines.en: : Same reason anyone comes here. To catch some waves and show off my beach body.
lines.zh: : 跟所有人来这儿的理由一样。冲几个浪，秀一下我的沙滩身材。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday5
: No, I meant why are you here {i}this early?{/i} Miyamura wouldn’t divulge to me why you decided to get a leg up on all of us and stay over on Thursday as well.
lines.zh: : 不，我是问你为什么{i}这么早{/i}就在这儿。Miyamura 不肯告诉我，你为什么决定抢在我们所有人前面、连周四也住过来。

lines.en: : Are you upset I didn’t invite you along?
lines.zh: : 你是在气我没叫上你吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, yes. I’ll take any excuse to get out of my apartment right now. Even if that excuse involves spending additional time beside the walking tragedy that is you.
lines.zh: : 有点，是的。现在只要是能让我离开公寓的借口，我都愿意接受。哪怕那个借口意味着要多花时间待在你这个行走的悲剧旁边。

lines.en: : I’d have liked an invite too, Senpai. You could have showed off your beach body to me privately if you were that excited about it.
lines.zh: : 我也想要一份邀请啊，Senpai。你要是这么兴奋，本来可以私下里只秀给我一个人看的。

lines.en: : I don’t like euphemisms, so I’m just going to directly say that I would have liked to have sex with you last night as well.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢委婉的说法，所以我就直说了：昨晚我也很想跟你做爱。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday6
: This complete lack of tact is why all of us are teachers and you aren’t.
lines.zh: : 这种完全没有分寸的样子，就是我们几个都是老师、而你不是的原因。

lines.en: : Is “tact” another word for “education?”
lines.zh: : 「分寸」是「学历」的另一种说法吗？

lines.en: : Arakawa-
lines.zh: : Arakawa——

lines.en: : I just wanted to get out of the house as well, Wakana. Please remember that I experience misery just as much as you. It’s important to my character.
lines.zh: : 我也只是想离开家而已，Wakana。请记住，我经历的痛苦不比你少。这对我的人物塑造很重要。

lines.en: : I see. Then, I suppose we can talk more about this later as it is far too early for me to be awake and I am going to nap until the sun sets.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那我们以后再聊吧，现在醒着对我来说太早了，我要睡到太阳下山。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday7
: We’re gonna head inside and get situated. Were you heading over to breakfast? A few of the girls were asking if you’d be there and I didn’t even realize you were already here.
lines.zh: : 我们要进去安顿一下。你是要去吃早餐吗？有几个女生在问你会不会去，我都没意识到你已经到了。

lines.en: : I suppose that would be the right thing to do. But I am only doing this because you asked and not because I want to see them in swimwear.
lines.zh: : 我想那是该做的事。不过我做这件事只是因为你问了，而不是因为我想看她们穿泳装的样子。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday8
: You know, with out-front honesty like that, I don’t really understand how I ever suspected you of anything.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，就冲你这种直白的坦诚，我真不明白我以前怎么会怀疑过你什么。

lines.en: : Senpai-
lines.zh: : Senpai——

lines.en: : Farewell, fellow adults.
lines.zh: : 再会了，各位成年人同仁。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday9
: Think we’ll get to see him take his shirt off if we follow him for a little while?
lines.zh: : 我们要是跟着他走一会儿，能看到他脱上衣吗？

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday10
I escape the first of many obstacles as I depart from the inn and follow the coastline, dialing the number of someone who, several days ago, informed me that she’d be receiving her “penance” today.
lines.zh: 我躲过了众多难关中的第一关，离开旅馆、沿着海岸线走，拨通了一个人的号码——几天前，她告诉我她今天要接受她的「苦修」。

lines.en: : {i}Hello?{/i}
That someone is Noriko if you are both blind and deaf but can communicate with me telepathically.
lines.zh: 那个人是 Noriko——除非你既瞎又聋，却还能跟我心灵感应。

lines.en: : Morning. Everything still going according to plan?
lines.zh: : 早上好。一切都还按计划进行吗？

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday11
: I’m not sure I’d call it a “plan” when I’m just hanging out in my room. But if you’re curious about whether or not Nee-chan knows where you are yet, I don’t think so.
lines.zh: : 我就在自己房间里待着，这算不算「计划」我可不好说。不过你要是想知道 Nee-chan 现在知不知道你在哪儿，我觉得还不知道。

lines.en: : {i}You’re still tagging along for press stuff then?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你还是跟着她去做宣传那套了？{/i}

lines.en: : Not like I had much of a choice when she came at me with, “It’s the least you can do to help after fucking my boyfriend.” Her big-sister card is so much stronger now and I hate it.
lines.zh: : 她冲我来一句「你把我男朋友睡了，帮这点忙总该吧」，我哪有什么选择。她的姐姐牌现在强得要命，我讨厌死了。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday12
: Have you seen Kirin’s new swimsuit yet? She wouldn’t shut up about wanting you to see it last night.
lines.zh: : 你看到 Kirin 的新泳衣了吗？她昨晚一直在念叨想让你看看。

lines.en: : {i}I haven’t seen anyone but the other teachers yet. I’m heading to breakfast now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}除了其他老师，我还没见过任何人。我现在正要去吃早餐。{/i}

lines.en: : Well, tell her she’s cute when you {i}do{/i} see her, okay? And tell me you miss me since I’ve earned at least that much for distracting Nee-chan until you get back.
lines.zh: : 那等你{i}真{/i}见到她的时候，记得说她可爱，好吗？还有，跟我说你想我——为了帮你拖住 Nee-chan 直到你回来，我至少该得到这个。

lines.en: : {i}I miss you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我想你。{/i}

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday13
: Ugh, great. Now I’m turned on. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 呃，好极了。我现在来感觉了。谢了啊。

lines.en: : It’s so unfair that you get to return to ground zero of my defloration while {i}I{/i} get to watch my sister bow and apologize all weekend.
lines.zh: : 真不公平，你能回到我破处那一夜的现场，而{i}我{/i}却得看我姐鞠躬道歉一整个周末。

lines.en: : I want {i}my{/i} back to hurt too, you know. Just for different reasons that all involve your penis and-
lines.zh: : 我也想让{i}我的{/i}背疼一疼，你知道吧。只不过疼的原因不一样，全都跟你的阴茎有关，还有——

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday14
: {i}Noriko? Are you-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Noriko？你在——{/i}

lines.en: : Go away! I’m masturbating!
lines.zh: : 走开！我在自慰！

lines.en: : {i}Ew! Are you dressed at least?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}恶心！你至少穿着衣服吧？{/i}

lines.en: : Mostly!
lines.zh: : 基本穿着！

lines.en: : {i}Well, hurry the fuck up! Mom wants you downstairs for breakfast!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就他妈快点！妈让你下楼吃早餐！{/i}

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday15

: {size=-2}I have to go, Onii-chan. I’d say try not to miss me too much, but what I really want is for you to think about me every time you walk past the room where we had five hours worth of hot pseudo-incestuous sex together.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我得挂了，Onii-chan。我本该说别太想我，但我真正想要的是：每次你走过那个我们一起度过了五个小时火辣伪乱伦性爱的房间时，都要想起我。{/size}

lines.en: : {i}I will. I promise. Before you go, though, were you also able to-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我会的。我保证。不过在你挂之前，你有没有也——{/i}

lines.en: : Nope. Ami laughed in my face and told me she wasn’t about to miss out on an opportunity to show off her lack of tits in front of you all weekend.
lines.zh: : 没有。Ami 当面嘲笑了我，说她才不会放过这个机会，在你面前炫耀她那平坦的胸部，一整个周末都要炫。

lines.en: : That’s not {i}exactly{/i} how she worded it and I may have embellished a little, but I know that’s what she meant. So she’s probably on her way to the beach now if she’s not already there.
lines.zh: : 她{i}原话{/i}不完全是这么说的，我可能添了点油加了点醋，但我知道她就是这个意思。所以她现在大概正在去海滩的路上，如果还没到的话。

lines.en: : {i}Tch. Got it. Thank you for trying.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啧。知道了。谢谢你去试了。{/i}

lines.en: : How {i}do{/i} you feel about flat chests by the way? Like, what’s your {i}ideal{/i} size? Should I be thinking about getting a reduction?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，你对平胸到底{i}怎么{/i}看？比如，你的{i}理想{/i}尺寸是多大？我是不是该考虑去缩一下？

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday16
I hang up the phone before I’m forced to make an impossible decision and-
lines.zh: 在被逼着做出一个不可能的抉择之前，我挂断了电话，然后——

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday17
Actually, hold that thought.
lines.zh: 等等，先别急。

lines.en: : Good morning, Touka. I-
lines.zh: : 早上好，Touka。我——

lines.en: : Die a thousand deaths. And then a thousand more.
lines.zh: : 去死一千次。然后再死一千次。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday18
: Oh. Okay.
lines.zh: : 哦。好吧。
: 那么……

lines.en: : Two thousand?
lines.zh: : 两千次？

lines.en: It appears that Touka is still mad at me for sleeping with Yasu. If she...even {i}knows{/i} I slept with Yasu and isn’t just wallowing in forced uncertainty while succumbing to my infectious pessimism.
lines.zh: 看来 Touka 还在为我和 Yasu 上床的事生我的气。前提是她{i}真的知道{/i}我跟 Yasu 上过床，而不是被逼着在不确定里挣扎，同时又被我那传染性的悲观拖下水。

lines.en: I’m not sure if I should apologize, though. But I’m not really sure how to approach her {i}at all{/i} right now, so here’s hoping someone {i}more{/i} approachable crosses my path next.
lines.zh: 不过我不确定该不该道歉。可我现在也根本不知道该怎么接近她，所以只能祈祷下一个出现在我面前的人{i}更好接近{/i}一点。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday19
: Sensei! There ya are! Here to catch some waves and show off that beach bod?
lines.zh: : Sensei！你在这儿啊！来冲浪、秀你那身沙滩身材的？

lines.en: : Oh, hey. I normally get the opposite of whatever I’m thinking about. Maybe this is is some sort of good omen and this weekend will be awesome?
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。我通常想到的都会反过来。也许这是个好兆头，这个周末会很棒？

lines.en: : How come you never come down here in swim trunks anymore? Miku and I haven’t gotten to feel up your abs since our first trip here.
lines.zh: : 你怎么再也不穿泳裤下来了？从我们第一次来这儿之后，我和 Miku 就再没摸过你的腹肌。

lines.en: : Can I feel yours? That swimsuit is so cute that I suddenly feel compelled to tear it into shreds and drown you in the ocean.
lines.zh: : 那我能摸你的吗？那件泳衣可爱到我突然很想把它撕成碎片，然后把你淹死在海里。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday20
: Oh, th...this old thing?...Y...You really think so? Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: : 哦，这……这条旧的吗？……你……你真这么觉得？哈哈……哈……

lines.en: : The heck was that drownin’ part for?
lines.zh: : 那句「淹死」是几个意思？

lines.en: : Cuteness aggression. Like how I want to push you down and strangle you right now.
lines.zh: : 可爱侵略症。就像我现在想把你按在地上掐死一样。

lines.en: : That one sounds kinda hot, though. We had a whole section for stuff like that at the porn shop before Maki decided to fire me over my secret relationship with some guy I met online.
lines.zh: : 不过那个听着还挺带感的。我们那家成人用品店以前有一整区都是卖这类东西的，后来 Maki 因为我在网上认识的某个男的、搞了段秘密恋情，就把我炒了。

lines.en: : You...mean me right?
lines.zh: : 你……说的是我吧？

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday21
: Oh, right. Kirin already knows you’re porkin’ me and I ain’t gotta pretend around her. Yeah, I mean you.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。Kirin 已经知道你在干我了，我在她面前也不用装。对，我说的是你。

lines.en: : I’ve technically only “porked you” once. But I don’t like that term, so I’m going to stop using it now.
lines.zh: : 严格来说我只「干过你」一次。不过我不喜欢这个说法，所以从现在起我不这么说了。

lines.en: : Hahah...heh...cute...he called me cute...
lines.zh: : 哈哈……嘿……可爱……他说我可爱……

lines.en: : Oi! Back to reality, Kirin. This {i}kawaii{/i} act you’ve got goin’ on is makin’ me feel all weird inside.
lines.zh: : 喂！回神了，Kirin。你这副{i}kawaii{/i}的样子看得我心里直发毛。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday22
: Oh! Yeah, I...{i}sorry.{/i} Just...nobody’s ever told me they want to drown me before.
lines.zh: : 哦！对，我……{i}抱歉{/i}。只是……从来没人跟我说过想把我淹死。

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} the part you liked?...
lines.zh: : 你喜欢的居然是{i}那{/i}部分？……

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. It’s like how I can’t look at Sensei without wanting to tie him to my sister’s bed and edge him for nine consecutive hours.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。就好像我一看 Sensei 就忍不住想把他绑在我姐的床上，连续九个小时吊着他。

lines.en: : Again, I think you guys are weavin’ this whole drowning thing into just general physical kinkiness and I ain’t really followin’.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，我觉得你俩是把「淹死」这件事编织进了某种泛泛的身体癖好里，我实在跟不上。

lines.en: : Is your sister here this time, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 你姐这次来了吗，Kirin？

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday23
: No. Why? Am I not enough for you or something?
lines.zh: : 没来。怎么？我一个人还不够你用吗？

lines.en: : Noriko taught Kirin the eye thing and now she won’t stop doin’ it any time she wants something.
lines.zh: : Noriko 教了 Kirin 那个眼神，现在她一想要什么就停不下来地用。

lines.en: : {i}Love me.{/i}
: I {i}do{/i} love you.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}爱你。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday24
: N...Not in public, you big jerk!
lines.zh: : 别……别在公共场合说，你这个大混蛋！

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday25
: Yeah, so that’s what I’ve been dealin’ with lately.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我最近一直在对付的就是这个。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday26
: Morning, you two! Love the new swimsuit, Molly. It really fits you.
lines.zh: : 早上好，你们俩！新泳衣真好看，Molly。很适合你。

lines.en: : Aye, doesn’t it?! Not bad for my first time creating my own swimwear, right?
lines.zh: : 是吧？！我第一次自己做泳衣，做成这样还不错吧？

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian has voiced her excitement on numerous occasions now over wearing this for approximately one hour before turning into a boiled crustaceous sea creature.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者已经多次表达过她的兴奋——为了穿上它大约一小时，然后变成一只煮熟的甲壳类海洋生物。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday27
: Oh, right. You get really bad sunburn, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。你晒伤特别严重，是吧？

lines.en: : I do. It is but one of the many reasons I refuse to go outside unless I am forced to. But there is a powerful, secret tincture one may use to combat the sun that not many know of!
lines.zh: : 是的。这只是我除非被逼、否则绝不出门的众多理由之一。不过有一种强力而秘密的药剂可以对抗太阳，知道的人可不多！

lines.en: : Molly, everyone uses sunscreen.
lines.zh: : Molly，大家都用防晒霜的。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday28

: But it feels so {i}weird!{/i} And half of its purpose goes out the window if you have no one to apply it for you. Such a thing is a quintessential pillar to nearly every single beach episode, you know. Yet here I am, untouched!
lines.zh: : 可它摸起来太{i}怪{/i}了！而且要是没人帮你涂，它一半的意义就全没了。这种事几乎是每一集海滩回的必备桥段，你知道吧。可我呢，没人给我涂！

lines.en: : I will apply the tincture for you, Emerald Guardian. It is the easiest way for you to obtain your cliche OVA moment.
lines.zh: : 我来给你涂，翡翠守护者。这是让你获得那段老套 OVA 桥段最简单的办法。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday29

: No thank you, Kendo Princess. I’d prefer the Supreme Overlord be the one to do it. But I feel as if there is a separate sticky white fluid he’d prefer to cover me with in the event that I actually ask.
lines.zh: : 不用了，谢谢，剑道公主。我更希望由至高霸主来涂。不过我感觉，要是我真开口了，他大概更想用另一种黏糊糊的白色液体把我涂满。

lines.en: : Yeah. I don’t think semen provides much protection from the sun, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 是啊。很遗憾，我觉得精液防晒的效果不怎么样。

lines.en: : This is true. But at least it tastes good.
lines.zh: : 确实。但至少它尝起来不错。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday30
: Um...what?
lines.zh: : 嗯……什么？

lines.en: : I said, “at least it tastes good.” And by “it,” I was referring to semen. Not sunscreen, as previously mentioned.
lines.zh: : 我说的是「至少它尝起来不错」。而这个「它」，指的是精液。不是前面提到的防晒霜。

lines.en: : Uhh...surprise? The Kendo Princess has joined the, uhh...{i}extracurricular activities{/i} club with the rest of us.
lines.zh: : 呃……惊喜吧？剑道公主也跟我们一起加入了那个……呃……{i}课外活动{/i}社。

lines.en: : I’m a bonafide whore now. Just like all of you. I can finally fit in.
lines.zh: : 我现在是个货真价实的荡妇了。就跟你们所有人一样。我终于能融入大家了。

lines.en: : Do you actually like the taste?
lines.zh: : 你是真喜欢那个味道？

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday31
: Wait, do you not?
lines.zh: : 等等，你不喜欢？

lines.en: : Are...Wait, are we all not just {i}pretending{/i} to like it? I didn’t think anyone actually {i}did.{/i} This is a joke, right?
lines.zh: : 等等……等等，我们不是都只是{i}假装{/i}喜欢吗？我以为没人真{i}喜欢{/i}。这是在开玩笑，对吧？

lines.en: : I like it. It tastes like love.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢。它尝起来像爱。

lines.en: : I don’t care either way. You can put me in the neutral party.
lines.zh: : 我无所谓。把我算中立派吧。

lines.en: : I could drink it by the gallon.
lines.zh: : 我能按加仑喝。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday32
: Even I think that’s too much, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 连我都觉得这有点过了，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : One glass of cum, please. Shaken, not stirred.
lines.zh: : 请来一杯精液。摇匀，不要搅拌。

lines.en: : I’m trying to get her to tone it down, I swear. She hasn’t yet discerned what is socially acceptable yet.
lines.zh: : 我发誓我一直在让她收敛点。她还没弄明白什么在社会上是可以接受的。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday33
: Yo! If it ain’t my favorite homie.
lines.zh: : 哟！这不是我最喜欢的哥们嘛。

lines.en: : Careful talking to me in public, Rin. The only brain cells left in your mom’s head are the ones she uses to protect you from my penis and she’s here right now.
lines.zh: : 在公共场合跟我说话小心点，Rin。你妈脑子里仅剩的脑细胞，都是用来保护你不被我的阴茎碰到的，而她现在就在这儿。

lines.en: : Is she? Because {i}I{/i} don’t see her. Which means it’s now safe to penis me as much as you like.
lines.zh: : 是吗？因为{i}我{/i}没看见她。也就是说，现在你想怎么用你的阴茎对我都可以，很安全。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday34

: Please! Gaze upon these breasts and ask yourself how they would feel within your hands! Think deeply of how they have unknowingly longed for your touch and ask, {i}why? How{/i} have I avoided them for so long?
lines.zh: : 求你了！好好看看这对胸，问问你自己，握在手里会是什么感觉！仔细想想，它们是如何不知不觉地渴望着你的触碰，然后问问自己：{i}为什么？我怎么{/i}能躲了它们这么久？

lines.en: if nikinudetrade == True:
: I mean, technically, I didn’t {i}completely{/i} avoid them thanks to Otoha. But I imagine that’s still a sore spot, so...
lines.zh: : 我是说，严格来讲，托 Otoha 的福，我并没有{i}完全{/i}躲开过它们。不过我想这还是个痛处，所以……

lines.en: : True! That was a very gross and bad thing you did, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没错！你干的那件事非常恶心、非常坏，Sensei。

lines.en: else:
: Hey, I did see them that one time when I opened your door while you were getting dressed.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我有一次确实看到了——你换衣服的时候我推开了你的门。

lines.en: : And yet you did not {i}seize{/i} them! How {i}dare{/i} you!
lines.zh: : 可你居然没有{i}下手{/i}！你{i}怎么敢{/i}！

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday35
: Regardless, we both know I like you now. So I was wondering if you wanted to add yourself to the list of tragic beach romances I’ve had in my life. As fleeting as the ocean itself.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我们现在都知道我喜欢你了。所以我想问问，你愿不愿意把自己加进我人生中那些海滩悲恋的名单里。就像大海本身一样转瞬即逝。

lines.en: : The ocean is a lot of things but I don’t think {i}fleeting{/i} is one of them, Rin. If anything, it’ll likely consume us all. I just hope I get to drown Kirin in it before that happens.
lines.zh: : 大海有很多特点，但我可不觉得{i}转瞬即逝{/i}是其中之一，Rin。要说的话，它更可能把我们全吞掉。我只希望在那之前，我能先把 Kirin 淹死在里面。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday36
: Oh, was your first instinct after seeing her new swimsuit {i}also{/i} to drown her? Because even I got that. And I’m very rarely ever attracted to her, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 哦，你看到她那件新泳衣之后的第一反应{i}也{/i}是想淹死她？因为连我都有这种冲动。说实话，我很少觉得她有吸引力。

lines.en: : I knew if anyone would understand my feelings, it would be you.
lines.zh: : 我就知道，要说谁能理解我的感受，那就是你。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday37
: Cause we’re besties, obviously. And, just to clarify, this is not me friend-zoning you like I have in the past.
lines.zh: : 因为我们 obviously 是死党啊。还有，先说清楚，这次我可不是像以前那样给你发好人卡。

lines.en: : I know now that we’re the kind of besties who are {i}best{/i} suited to {i}ease{/i} the growing tension between us with the assistance of our bodies.
lines.zh: : 我现在明白了，我们属于那种最{i}适合{/i}用身体来{i}缓解{/i}彼此之间越积越多的张力的死党。

lines.en: : That was so incredibly dumb. But very fitting if you are trying to flirt right now. It’s nice being on this end of your awkward advances for once.
lines.zh: : 这话蠢得离谱。不过如果你是在调情，那倒是挺合适的。偶尔处在你笨拙示好的接收端，感觉还不错。

lines.en: : And it’s nice feeling comfortable enough to awkwardly advance on you! Which is why I’d like to invite you into my pants tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 能舒服到可以笨拙地对你发起攻势，这种感觉也很好！所以我想邀请你明天进我的裤子里。

lines.en: : I can’t tell if you actually meant to say pants there not.
lines.zh: : 我说不好你到底是不是真的想说「裤子」。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday38
: Did I say pants? I didn’t mean to say pants. I didn’t even {i}bring{/i} pants.
lines.zh: : 我说裤子了吗？我不是想说裤子。我根本没{i}带{/i}裤子。

lines.en: : So are you just inviting me out on some sort of date then? Do I get the same confession treatment everybody else got?
lines.zh: : 那你是在约我出去、算是某种约会？我能享受到跟其他人一样的告白待遇吗？

lines.en: : It doesn’t need to be a {i}date,{/i} per se. I just want to hang out with you tomorrow since we’ve never really gotten that chance here before apart from scattered mental breakdowns.
lines.zh: : 倒也不一定非得是{i}约会{/i}。我只是想明天跟你待一会儿，因为除了零散的几次精神崩溃之外，我们从没在这儿真正有过这种机会。

lines.en: : Why tomorrow? Why not tonight?
lines.zh: : 为什么是明天？今晚不行吗？

lines.en: : Because this is the day where you go around and talk to everybody and they all fight over your attention since {i}they{/i} want you tonight.
lines.zh: : 因为今天你会到处跟每个人说话，而她们都会为了抢你的注意力打得不可开交，因为{i}她们{/i}想要的是今晚的你。

lines.en: : But if I invite you to do stuff {i}tomorrow,{/i} you’ll be more inclined to say yes since nobody else has brought anything {i}up{/i} about tomorrow yet. It’s a calculated move. I’m sneaky now.
lines.zh: : 可我要是约你{i}明天{/i}，你更可能答应，因为还没有别人{i}提{/i}过明天的事。这是算计好的一步。我现在很狡猾了。

lines.en: : Well done, Rin. So well done that I’ll agree right here and now.
lines.zh: : 干得漂亮，Rin。漂亮到我现在就在这儿答应你。

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure? Because if you agree and then something happens and you don’t show up tomorrow, I’m just never coming to the beach again.
lines.zh: : 你百分之百确定？因为如果你答应了，结果出了什么事、明天你没来，那我就再也不来海滩了。

lines.en: : I am absolutely sure. And I also promise to not tell your mom about it while I am having sex with her tonight.
lines.zh: : 我百分之百确定。而且我还保证，今晚我和你妈做爱的时候不会把这事告诉她。

lines.en: : Thank you, Sensei. I appreciate that. But please be careful with her. She is very old and likely breakable. And she gives me an allowance now that she is employed that I would like to keep.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Sensei。我很感激。不过请对她温柔点。她年纪很大了，估计挺脆的。而且她现在有工作，会给我零花钱，我还想继续拿呢。

lines.en: : Oh man. I wanted you to get embarrassed and blush and beg me not to sleep with her. Now, I’m going to feel bad when I ultimately do.
lines.zh: : 哦，天哪。我本来想让你难为情、脸红、求我别跟她上床的。这下等我真睡了她，我会内疚的。

lines.en: : Another calculated move. I’m just always going to be one step ahead of you now. I know you too well, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 又一步算计。从现在起我永远都比你快一步。我太了解你了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I assume the way you’re standing is also calculated, then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜你站姿也是算计好的？

lines.en: : Oh, have you noticed the fact that I’ve been slightly pushing out my chest this whole time? And hiding my arms behind my back to emphasize it and appear both comfortable and defenseless?
lines.zh: : 哦，你注意到我全程都在微微挺胸了吗？还有把胳膊藏在背后，好突出它，显得我既放松又毫无防备？

lines.en: : You’re good.
lines.zh: : 你可以啊。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday39

: Just because I’m late to join the party doesn’t mean I’m at a disadvantage, Sensei. I’ve got the power of friendship on my side. And everyone knows the best relationships form with a foundation like that.
lines.zh: : 我入场晚，不代表我就处于劣势，Sensei。我这边有友情的力量。而且谁都知道，最好的感情都是建立在这样的基础上的。

lines.en: : Ah, maybe you {i}should{/i} just date Molly then.
lines.zh: : 啊，那你{i}或许{/i}该直接跟 Molly 交往算了。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday40
: Mmph...Real nice, buddy.
lines.zh: : 嗯……真有你的啊，哥们。

lines.en: : See you tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 明天见？

lines.en: : Is it customary for the boy or the girl to bring condoms when sex is a possibility? I’ve never been heterosexual before.
lines.zh: : 要是可能发生性关系，一般是男方还是女方带避孕套？我以前从来没当过异性恋。

lines.en: : Condoms are a psy-op created by the pharmaceutical industry to perpetuate Japan’s birthrate crisis. I’m not bringing any and neither will you.
lines.zh: : 避孕套是制药产业为了延续日本少子化危机而搞出来的心理战。我不会带，你也不许带。

lines.en: scene beachsevenfriday41
: Okaaaaaay. But if you knock me up, you’re going to have to cover all of my shifts at the cafe and find a babysitter for our child that isn’t my mom.
lines.zh: : 好————吧。但要是你把我肚子搞大了，你就得替我顶掉咖啡馆所有的班，还得给咱们的孩子找个不是我妈的保姆。

lines.en: : Again, I will keep that in mind when I am having sex with her tonight.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，今晚我和她做爱的时候，我会牢记这一点。

lines.en: : Please don’t think of me while having sex with my mom because it implies you’ll be thinking about her while having sex with me.
lines.zh: : 跟我妈做爱的时候请别想我，因为那就意味着你跟我做爱的时候会想着她。
